title: Compact mobile monitor details
description: Use an existing monitor with checks. No state is seeded and no provider mutation is performed. Start with its details collapsed.

open.cmd: adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "farmslot-development:///pr-automation?monitorId={{params.monitor_id}}" net.siteed.farmslot.development
open.intent: The monitor link makes the requested subscription accessible without scrolling past unrelated history.

summary.intent: The collapsed card offers an accessible disclosure for its details.

collapsed.intent: Record the compact summary before opening detailed check history.

expand.intent: The operator opens details for one monitor at a time.

scroll.intent: The check disclosure is reachable without rendering the full CI history.

checks.intent: The operator chooses when the potentially long CI list is displayed.

opened.intent: The check list disclosure records its expanded state.

capture.intent: Record expanded checks under the same monitor.

hide.intent: Closing checks restores access to the monitor actions without a long scroll.

hidden.intent: The disclosure returns to its compact state after closing.

final.intent: Record the restored compact layout and reachable actions.
